title: Crew Surcharge on Freight Rebookings - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
A rebooked Large Item Freight Delivery of a Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders purchase carries a crew surcharge that depends on the merchandise billed on the order, that is, the total amount billed on the order's line charges.

**Schedule.** The crew surcharge is $25.00 where the merchandise billed is $400.00 or more, $15.00 where it is at least $200.00 but below $400.00, and none below $200.00. The surcharge is a fixed dollar amount, not a percentage.

| Merchandise billed on the line charges | Crew surcharge |
|---|---|
| $400.00 or more | $25.00 |
| $200.00 to $399.99 | $15.00 |
| Below $200.00 | None |

### Both sides of each threshold

| Merchandise billed | Crew surcharge |
|---|---|
| $199.99 | None |
| $200.00 | $15.00 |
| $399.99 | $15.00 |
| $400.00 | $25.00 |

**What is counted.** Only the order's line charges, at the amount billed on them; the freight fee and redelivery fees are fees, not merchandise.

**Example (hypothetical).** A freight order whose single line charge for a dog crate and bed set was billed at $312.40 carries a $15.00 crew surcharge on a rebooking.
